## Find WordPress & WooCommerce Plugins with High Active Installs & 1-Star Churn Reviews
**Powered by StoreIntel Labs on Apify:** [WordPress Plugin Directory Scraper: Active Installs, Support & Reviews](https://apify.com/storeintel/wordpress-plugin-directory-scraper)

Query the official WordPress.org Plugin API for active installs, support thread resolution rates, PHP/WP compatibility, donate/commercial links, and 1-star user reviews.

### Quick Setup (30 seconds)
1. Get your free Apify API token at `https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations`.
2. Open the **Run StoreIntel Apify Actor** node and paste your token in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`).
3. Customize the JSON input body or connect it to your Google Sheet / Webhook trigger.

### Pre-Configured Apify Task Templates
- [WooCommerce & WordPress Plugin Active Installs & Developer Leads Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/woocommerce-plugin-active-installs-leads-scraper)
